summary: The Verge profiles Thai Food Near Me, a Manhattan restaurant named after a literal Google search in a bet on SEO, and other businesses that adopted "near me" names. Google's Danny Sullivan doubts the name helps ranking directly, but the viral joke produced press and posts that boosted the restaurant's prominence anyway. The piece also looks at how owners tailor businesses to platforms and algorithms, from names to menus.
one_line: A New York Thai restaurant named Thai Food Near Me shows how businesses chase Google SEO, and how its viral name helped even if the naming trick didn't.
key_facts: Thai Food Near Me is a New York restaurant in the Murray Hill neighborhood of Manhattan, named after a literal Google search; it has four owners including Teddy Jirapraphanan and Robert Sampson.
The term "Thai food near me" is searched nearly a million times a month in the US on average, according to Semrush, which grades it "difficult" to rank for.
In March, a photo of the restaurant with butcher paper still on the windows went viral on Twitter before opening, and the Google Maps account replied "Very relatable" with a crown emoji.
Danny Sullivan, Google's public liaison for Search, said "I doubt it" when asked if the name boosted its ranking, and said Google uses data like location, reviews, and ratings.
Google's public documentation says local results are ranked by relevance, distance, and prominence; prominence includes links, traditional search ranking, and press coverage.
The author's Google Maps search for "Thai food near me" from Brooklyn did not show the restaurant, but a search from Wisconsin surfaced it above local businesses.
Other "near me" businesses include a chain of half a dozen Affordable Dentist Near Me's in Texas, seven Plumber Near Me businesses, and more than 20 "Notary Near Me" iterations across the US.
Felix Silva named his Coral Springs, Florida shop Barber Shop Near Me in 2019 after considering more than 20 options; its logo is a red location pin resembling Google's.
Silva says an acquaintance rebranded his Christmas tree business as Christmas Trees Near Me, and there are other Barber Shop Near Me shops in Oak Park, Queens, and Muskogee.
Sampson says that for the first several months, most customers came from Twitter and Reddit posts rather than Google results, and some walked in after noticing the sign.
The owners tweaked their menu and modification options on delivery apps like Uber Eats and DoorDash based on customer requests; Sampson says "We now want to make it however you most want it."
Thai Food Near Me is at least the fourth Thai restaurant to occupy its location, though Jirapraphanan was told it is the fifth.
